name: l2cap_connect_handler

ownership.argument: Bluelet owner-only handler; it is reached exactly through the public wrapper, so the two form the connect binding pair.

provenance.source: Submitted by the public wrapper bt_l2cap_connect 0xC805B0C. Reads the request block: psm at +2, flags byte at +8 (bit0 selects LE), psm entry at +12 (filled from l2cap_find_le_psm when zero), cid pair at +16/+20, state byte at +23 (1 = LE, 2 = BR). Creates the descriptor with 0xC8004F4(request+16, le), binds it through 0xC7FF93C, sets the channel flags word +114 bit 0x100 and writes the assigned cid back to request+0.

notes: Bluelet owner-only handler; it is reached exactly through the public wrapper, so the two form the connect binding pair.
